gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-yi: Woodgod stands tall and vintage, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Noto Sans Yi follows with a deep midsection and unsealed rounds, so a long passage moves along in a modern, businesslike way.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square reads friendly and current, with a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. Woodgod adds vintage command on top.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-traditional-n: That wide channel cut into every Woodgod bowl gives it a vintage, commanding look, while Noto Traditional Nushu relaxes into a broad-nibbed stroke. The pair's strongest quality is its friendly gruffness.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-numans: Tall, stern and a bit old-fashioned. Woodgod leads, and Numans answers with widely spaced tracking and hanging s shapes, which is the pair's strongest quality: a vintage shout beside a modern, airy whisper.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-onest: Commanding in tone, Woodgod runs its tall lowercase right up toward the capitals above the page. And Onest, with short ascenders and big bowls, reads smoothly and steadily across a longer passage.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-open-sans: Vintage in feel, Woodgod uses a wide channel into every bowl and tall lowercase that nearly touches the capitals. But Open Sans brings the strongest quality here: smooth, bulky letters with no clogged curves.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-orienta: Orienta has counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open, with little height difference between its cases. Yet Woodgod above it stays commanding and vintage, so the two make a lively, mismatched page.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-oxygen: Oxygen keeps its curves open, never closing back on themselves, and its lowercase nearly matches its capitals in height. Woodgod above it adds a vintage, commanding voice.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-parkinsans: Woodgod brings commanding vintage presence, with a wide channel into every bowl and lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. Parkinsans simply stays crisp when shrunk, built from rounded single-weight rods.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-preahvihear: Tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals gives Woodgod its commanding, vintage stance, and Preahvihear sits below with a lofty x-height. Woodgod is best at announcing; Preahvihear is best at opening its letters wide.
